title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
description: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.

title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
description: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.

title: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
description: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.

title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
description: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.

title: Who’s really in charge at Anthropic after the IPO?
description: Here's a clear explanation of Anthropic's incredibly complex governance structure.

title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
description: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
description: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
description: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
description: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
description: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
description: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
description: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown fourteenfold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
description: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
description: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
description: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
description: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.

title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
description: The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest.

title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
description: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
